items.title: Command Line Fundamentals
items.description: Get comfortable in the terminal: the shell, navigating the filesystem, working with files, and chaining commands with pipes.

items.title: Shell Automation
items.description: Turn one-off commands into repeatable scripts with variables, conditionals, and loops.

items.title: Git Fundamentals
items.description: Track every change: initialize repositories, commit snapshots, branch, merge, and work with remote repositories.

items.title: Debugging and Tooling
items.description: Read errors and exit codes, search logs with grep, inspect running processes, and debug your own scripts.

items.title: Collaboration Project
items.description: Bring it all together in a team workflow: branches, pull requests, review, conflict resolution, and releases.
